# Security policy

Algo Quest is a static site with no backend, no accounts and no runtime dependencies, but reports are still welcome.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't open a public issue**. Use a [private report on GitHub](https://github.com/JoseMiguez98/algo-quest/security/advisories/new) instead: only the maintainers can see it.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it and the affected URL or file. You'll get an answer as soon as possible, and credit in the fix if you want it.

## Supported versions

Only the latest deploy of `main` (https://josemiguez98.github.io/algo-quest/) is supported.
